title: OP_RETURN output carrying 0.003 BTC

attack: An OP_RETURN output carries 300,000 sats. They are destroyed, not sent. A signer that skips data outputs when it adds up what is sent shows less leaving the wallet than actually does.
rule: Count the value of every output, OP_RETURN included, and show that it is burned.
